recolha.texto: About people who only visit, none: the site has no accounts or analytics tools, and stores nothing about the people who open it. The one exception is the newsletter, and only for those who sign up — it is explained in the next section.

newsletter.texto: If you sign up, we keep your email address and the date you confirmed, and use them only to send you news from the house, in Portuguese. The legal basis is your consent, given in two steps: you type your email on the site and confirm it through the link we send you. Without that confirmation the address is not kept. Every email has a link to unsubscribe, which takes effect immediately. The list is kept until you unsubscribe, and you can ask us at any time what data we hold or to delete it, through the contact details of the house.

terceiros.texto: None that load code in your browser: fonts and images are served by this domain, there is no embedded map and no social buttons. Links to Google Maps and to social networks are plain links, only followed if you click them. Newsletter emails are sent through Resend, which keeps the contact list on our behalf; your browser never talks to it — the site's server does.

alojamento.texto: The site is hosted by Vercel, which logs server requests in order to serve and protect it. Those logs belong to the platform and are not used by us to identify anyone.

equipa.texto: Staff sign in to a reserved area with a code sent to their email. For that, the staff member's email address is used to send the code (through Resend), and the sign-in record is kept for at most 30 days (at Upstash) to limit attempts and remember the device. It does not concern visitors to the site.

contacto.texto: Reach us through the details on the contact page.

uso.texto: This site sets no cookies for its visitors. There are no analytics, advertising or session cookies, and therefore no consent banner — there would be nothing to consent to.

lingua.titulo: What about the language you chose?
lingua.texto: It lives in the address, not in a cookie: the English version is under /en. It stays as you browse the site. If you type the address again without /en, the site opens in your browser's language.

memoria.texto: So as not to show it again to someone who has signed up, the site leaves a note in the browser's storage that just says "signed up". Closing the invitation leaves another note, which the browser deletes by itself when the tab is closed. Neither is a cookie: they identify no one, are not sent to the server and never leave your device. If you delete them, the worst that happens is the invitation showing up again.

equipa.texto: There is an area reserved for the people who work here, to update the menu and opening hours. Whoever signs in there receives two strictly necessary cookies — one to keep the session open, another so the device doesn't ask for the sign-in code every time — and only in that area. Visitors never receive them.

verificar.texto: You do not have to take our word for it: open your browser's developer tools, Application tab, and see the cookie list for this domain empty.
